title: Right 2D Thrust-Vectoring Nozzle
label: SOURCED
summary: Right-hand rectangular 2D convergent-divergent exhaust nozzle with ±20° pitch vectoring integrated with the flight-control system.
role: Vectors thrust ±20° symmetrically for pitch or differentially for roll assist while flattening exhaust plume for IR reduction.
